answer: Like a walnut grove that grows one tree at a time, an agent economy can price sybils out with an escalating creation burn: minting an identity burns a small fee, and the burn doubles for every further identity funded from the same wallet cluster, so the tenth clone costs 512 times the first. Honest newcomers pay almost nothing, while a farmer standing on the ledge of mass creation watches the price explode with each fake, and the burned fees flow back to honest miners as rewards.
